title: chore: add patch changeset for 4.0.2 release
body:
Adds the changeset file to trigger a `4.0.1 → 4.0.2` patch bump across all 39 packages in the `fixed` group, and promotes the accumulated `[Unreleased]` CHANGELOG entries to `[4.0.2]`.

## Changes

- **`.changeset/patch-release-4-0-2.md`** — marks every package in the `fixed` group as `patch`; `changeset version` will rewrite all `package.json` versions atomically
- **`CHANGELOG.md`** — `[Unreleased]` promoted to `[4.0.2] - 2026-05-08`; fresh empty `[Unreleased]` placeholder left above it

## Covered in this patch

- `editMode: 'page'` record forms + `navigate_create` / `navigate_edit` actions (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/types`)
- `ComponentRegistry` singleton leak in `plugin-list` / `plugin-detail` dist builds (all `@object-ui/*` deps externalised)
- `CreateViewDialog` `existingSet` memo churn fix
- CI: jsdom hex color tolerance in `ReportViewer` test; i18n mock shape fix in `ObjectView` test

## To release

```bash
pnpm changeset:version   # consumes changeset, bumps package.json files
pnpm build
pnpm changeset:publish   # publishes to npm
```
